input.command: $os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; "Free: {0:N1} GB" -f ($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1MB); $c = Get-Process chrome -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "Chrome: {0} processes, {1:N1} GB" -f @($c).Count, ((@($c) | Measure-Object WorkingSet64 -Sum).Sum/1GB)
input.description: Check free RAM and Chrome usage
